text.p: -- Robertson Stephens analyst Patrick Tenney raised his fiscal 1998 earnings estimate for Quantum Corp to $5.15 a share from $3.75 a share based on improved gross margins in the company's high end disk drive business. Tenney said the high end business which had been losing money, turned a profit in the fourth quarter, before he had expected.

-- PaineWebber analyst Paul Weinstein raised his fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $5.20 a share from $4.30 a share. Weinstein said the increase was due to better than expected revenues in the fourth quarter and the improved gross margins.
-- Quantum was 11/16 higher at 42-3/8 in afternoon trading on Nasdaq.
